'''May 2000 Williston Park tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Grasshoppers, Williston Park, NY on 20 May 2000. [[Garth McLaren]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d862">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-williston-park-ny-5-20-00-buck-beats-med862/ williston-park-ny-5-20-00-buck-beats-me], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 9 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-09-williston-park-ny-5-20-00-buck-beats-med862/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Grasshoppers, Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[Garth McLaren]]
